name: Nissui Corporation
summary: Nissui Corporation engages in marine, food products, fine chemicals, general distribution, and other businesses in Japan, North America, South America, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers salmon, tuna, Japanese amberjack, Alaska pollock, and Farmed salmon trout; marine foods and chilled products, frozen ready meals, and other species; fried marine foods; Chikuwa fish cake; and frozen fishes, and foods for specified health uses, as well as produces and sells formula feed for farmed fish.
